title: Performance Optimization & Web Vitals
summary: Systematic techniques for sub-second page loads, minimal server latency, and low memory consumption.
keyPrinciples: Measure before optimizing: profile production bottlenecks with Chrome DevTools and APM tools.
The fastest code is the code that never runs: cache early, prune dependencies, avoid unnecessary work.
Protect the main thread: avoid long tasks (>50ms) to ensure instant user interaction.

rules.title: Prevent N+1 Query Traps in Database Relationships
rules.description: Fetching associated records inside a loop generates N separate roundtrips to the database instead of a single batched query.

badExample.explanation: Introduces massive database network roundtrip latency.

goodExample.code:
// Good: Single SQL JOIN or batched DataLoader query
const posts = await db.query(`
  SELECT p.*, json_build_object('id', u.id, 'name', u.name) as author
  FROM posts p
  INNER JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id
  LIMIT 100
`);
goodExample.explanation: Executes in one single database roundtrip with zero sequential wait times.

rules.title: Declare Explicit Dimensions on Media Elements to Eliminate CLS
rules.description: Images without explicit aspect-ratio or width/height attributes trigger layout shifts when loaded, disrupting user reading position.

badExample.explanation: Browser assumes 0x0 size until image header is parsed, jumping the layout.

goodExample.explanation: Space is pre-allocated immediately; Cumulative Layout Shift score stays 0.

productionChecklist: Core Web Vitals monitored via real-user monitoring (RUM).
Critical images above the fold preloaded with fetchpriority='high'.
Database queries indexed on foreign keys and WHERE/ORDER BY columns.
Asset bundling configured with modern code-splitting and brotli compression.
